newsitem.title: USA: Montana wheat harvest speeds ahead in latest week.
newsitem.headline: Montana wheat harvest speeds ahead in latest week.

text.p: Montana wheat harvesting sped ahead in the week ended on August 25 but the hot, dry weather continues to cause worries of brushfires, the Montana Agricultural Statistics Service said in its weekly update.
Winter wheat was 92 percent harvested as of Sunday against 65 percent a week ago, 49 a year ago and 64 on a five-year average.

Spring wheat was 58 percent harvested against 34 y/a, 34 avg. Srping wheat was 85 percent ripened versus 65 percent average. Spring wheat was rated 30 percent good or better, unchanged from last week, and 41 percent fair, down from 46 percent.

Barley harvested 51 percent vs 27 y/a, 36 avg. Barley was 85 percent ripe against an average 67 pct usually at this time. Barley was rated 30 percent good or better, down from 32 percent last week, and 37 percent fair, down from 41 percent.
Oats were 50 percent harvested and 83 pct ripe. Oats were rated 36 percent good or better, down from 43 pct last week.
Topsoil moisture statewide was rated 55 percent very short versis 48 pct last week, and 37 percent short.
